user.title: Connect to your camera
user.description: Setup reads the camera list and does not change the device.

data_description.host: Address of the recorder, or of a single camera.
data_description.username: A user on the device that is allowed to talk.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: {host} rejected the saved sign in. Enter it again.

reconfigure.title: Update the connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address, port, or sign in. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: Address of the recorder, or of a single camera.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the saved password.

error.no_talk_channels: Connected, but no camera on this device can talk.

abort.wrong_device: That address is a different device. Add it as a new device.

init.title: Advanced Reolink Card options
init.description: The camera list was checked when this page opened. Sleeping cameras are listed and wake when they need to speak. Cameras that cannot talk: {unsupported}.

data.live_talk_non_admin: Let other people use live talk

data_description.voice: Any Microsoft Edge neural voice name.
data_description.volume: 100 percent plays the audio as it is. Higher values make it louder and may distort.
data_description.enabled_channels: Only these cameras get a speaker, and actions refuse the rest.
data_description.live_talk_non_admin: Live talk on the card is for administrators unless this is on.
data_description.configure_patrol: Next, pick a camera that can pan and set its patrol.

patrol_camera.title: Choose a camera
patrol_camera.description: Only cameras that can pan are listed.

patrol_settings.title: Patrol for {camera}
patrol_settings.description: Defaults for patrol on {camera}. The card measures the left limit and the right limit. An automation can override these. Set both limits to 0 to sweep the full range.

data_description.enabled: When off, patrol refuses this camera.
data_description.left_time: Seconds to pan left from the home position. Use 0 when the home position is the left limit.
data_description.right_time: Seconds to pan right from the home position to the right limit.
data_description.speed: From 1 to 64. The limits were measured at this sweep speed.
data_description.tilt_levels: How many tilt rows to use. 1 keeps the current tilt.
data_description.tilt_step: Seconds to tilt down between rows.

error.patrol_value_range: A value is outside its allowed range.
error.patrol_arc_incomplete: Set a right limit as well, or clear the left limit.

abort.no_ptz_channels: This device has no cameras that can pan.

invalid_auth.message: The device rejected the saved username or password.

not_a_speaker.message: {entity_id} is not an Advanced Reolink Card speaker.

target_required.message: Choose a camera speaker or a camera number.

no_entry_loaded.message: No Advanced Reolink Card device is set up.

multiple_entries.message: More than one device is set up. Choose the camera or the device as well as the camera number.

channel_not_enabled.message: {name} is not allowed to talk. Turn it on in the options.

talk_timeout.message: {name} did not answer in time. It may be asleep or out of range. {error}

nothing_to_play.message: Nothing to play. Add a message or a media item.

path_not_allowed.message: {path} is outside the folders Home Assistant is allowed to read.

ptz_not_supported.message: {name} cannot pan, so it cannot patrol.

patrol_not_configured.message: {name} needs a list of presets for this patrol.

patrol_target_required.message: Choose a camera, a device, or a camera number.

patrol_target_unknown.message: Could not match {target} to a camera.

patrol_guard_required.message: {name} needs a home position before this patrol can run. Open the camera and choose Set up patrol.

patrol_arc_incomplete.message: Set a right limit as well (left {left_time}, right {right_time}), or set both to 0 for a full range sweep.

say.name: Say
say.description: Speak a message through a camera speaker.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Speaker for the camera. Use this or a camera number.

channel.name: Camera number
channel.description: Camera number, starting at 0. Use this or a camera.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with a camera number when more than one device is set up.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: Microsoft Edge voice name. Overrides the default.

volume.name: Volume
volume.description: Loudness in percent. 100 leaves the audio as it is.

play_file.name: Play audio
play_file.description: Play an audio file or media item on a camera speaker.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: A Home Assistant media item, a web address, or a local file in an allowed folder.

start_patrol.name: Start patrol
start_patrol.description: Patrol a camera that can pan. Uses a saved patrol, a list of presets, or a sweep between the left limit and the right limit. Empty options use the camera settings, then the defaults. The camera returns to the home position at the end.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: A speaker from this integration, or a camera from the Reolink integration.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: A device from this integration, or a Reolink camera device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with a camera number when more than one device is set up.

patrol_id.name: Saved patrol
patrol_id.description: Name or number of a patrol saved on the camera. Used when presets is empty.

presets.name: Presets
presets.description: Preset names or numbers to visit, in order.

dwell.name: Wait at each preset
dwell.description: Seconds to wait at each preset. Default 10.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop after this many seconds, then return to the home position.

loops.name: Loops
loops.description: How many times to repeat the preset list or the sweep.

return_preset.name: Return preset
return_preset.description: Preset to use when finished. If empty, the camera returns to the home position.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Auto uses presets when you pass them, otherwise a patrol saved on the camera, otherwise a sweep. You can also choose native, presets, or sweep.

sweep_time.name: Full range time
sweep_time.description: Seconds for one side of a full range sweep. Used only when no limits are set.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Seconds to hold at each end of a sweep. Default 2.

tilt_levels.name: Tilt rows
tilt_levels.description: How many tilt rows to sweep. Default 1, which keeps the current tilt.

tilt_step.name: Tilt step
tilt_step.description: Seconds to tilt down between rows. Default 2.

zoom_out_first.name: Zoom out first
zoom_out_first.description: Zoom all the way out before the sweep.

disable_tracking.name: Pause auto tracking
disable_tracking.description: Turn auto tracking off during the sweep and restore it afterwards.

left_time.name: Left limit
left_time.description: Seconds to pan left from the home position. Use 0 when the home position is the left limit.

right_time.name: Right limit
right_time.description: Seconds to pan right from the home position to the right limit.

arc.name: Sweep limits
arc.description: Two numbers, left limit then right limit, in seconds.

settle_time.name: Pause at the home position
settle_time.description: Seconds to wait at the home position before a limited sweep.

stop_patrol.name: Stop patrol
stop_patrol.description: Stop a patrol that is running.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: A device from this integration, or a Reolink camera device.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with a camera number when more than one device is set up.

set_patrol_limits.name: Save patrol settings
set_patrol_limits.description: Save patrol settings for one camera. Only the fields you set are changed. Set both limits to 0 for a full range sweep.
